text: ポケモンが　とても　きもちよさそうに　ねています

structure.jp: とても　きもちよさそうに

patterns.name: 〜そう (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう on a describing word means 'looks that way'. いい becomes よさそう, and に lets it describe how the action is done. きもちよさそうに = 'looking like it feels good'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on right now. ねています = 'is sleeping'.
